inbox.text: International break: the window runs 22 Mar to 30 Mar, and your fixtures do not stop for it, so they went straight after your last game. Away with their countries (Mali: Aliou Dieng; North Macedonia: Stole Dimitrievski; Guinea: Mouctar Diakhaby). They are back for the Rayo Vallecano game. Aliou Dieng, Stole Dimitrievski and Mouctar Diakhaby started for their countries. The long trips hurt most. Your assistant wants to know: start them against Rayo Vallecano, or rest the spent ones for that one game?

options.label: Rest the ones who are spent
Pick them anyway

inbox.resolved: That game has been and gone.

inbox.text: One of your defenders and another of the senior lads got matching tattoos to celebrate a win. Neither remembers deciding this.

options.label: Fine them both
Team bonding is team bonding

inbox.text: One of your midfielders has taken up open water swimming in January and keeps posting about it at six in the morning.

options.label: Ask the physio to have a word
Join him once, for the group chat

pending.text: Word is Filip Ugrinic has asked to leave. Is he still your player?

options.label: He is going nowhere
options.line: You slammed the door shut in public. He is flattered. The board wanted the money.

options.label: If he wants out, he can go
options.line: You put him on the list live on air. Ruthless, and the room respected it.

options.label: We are talking. Leave it with us
options.line: You said nothing at all, at length. Tomorrow they will write it themselves.

decisions.text: The head coach flags Aliou Dieng: his morale is down at 13, the lowest in the first team squad, and a word from the manager would help.

options.label: Take him for a coffee (his morale +6)
Leave it to the coach (nothing changes)

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A columnist has written that your side has no plan. The press officer wants to know whether you will answer it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: The board have £200k spare this quarter and want to know where you want it. They will put it in the transfer pot if you ask, and they would read holding it back as a careful manager.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: Javi Guerra was shown a straight red against Real Betis and is banned for 2 matches. The club secretary rates an appeal at 25 percent. It is his second red of the season, which the panel will not ignore. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 3 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 2 matches ban stood.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
